Uber Technologies operates a technology platform connecting consumers with mobility, delivery, and freight services (“Uber,” 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, line 181). The company reports results through three segments: Mobility, Delivery, and Freight ("Uber," 10-K accession 0001543151-26-000015, line 184).

Management highlights a focus on expanding supply in the Mobility segment, building momentum in Delivery, and deepening engagement across its platform (8-K accession 0001543151-26-000039, lines 7-9). They also emphasize translating growth into profitability with record operating income margins (8-K accession 0001543151-26-000039, line 9).
